description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: BrowserWindow created in src/main/main.ts with 1200x800, contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false, and preload pointing to dist/preload/preload.js

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: DocumentList component renders all documents from IPC; shows 'No documents yet' empty state when list is empty; includes file input for .txt/.md import

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: QuestionPanel component calls window.knowledgeBase.qa.ask() on Enter or button click; disabled while request is in-flight

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService constructor calls ensureDirectories() which creates knowledge-base-data/ plus content/, chunks/, and index/ subdirectories using app.getPath('userData')
